cpu_interpretation: Zero ticks means below kernel accounting resolution, not zero computation
background_environment: Concurrent development and Docker Desktop tests; no host isolation, no sustained load proof
method: One sequential 60 s run per mode; procfs sampled at 100 ms and PTY 120x35; warm filesystem cache
scope: One existing Docker Desktop cluster, one small isolated read-only namespace; no cluster writes
request_count_limitation: TLS network traffic does not prove HTTP request counts; no API audit or request instrumentation used

live_cli_watch.limitation: Snapshot and clean consumer-close tested; resource mutations intentionally delegated to separate acceptance suite
